body:
## Pull request overview

This PR aims to fix CI pipeline failures by correcting vitest setup file references and addressing lint errors. The changes include updating 10 package configuration files and fixing code issues in field widgets.

**Changes:**
- Updated vitest setup file references from `vitest.setup.ts` to `vitest.setup.tsx` across 10 vite.config.ts files
- Added package aliases in vite configs to support vitest.setup.tsx imports during test runs
- Fixed Math.random() lint error in BooleanField.tsx by using React's useId() hook
- Attempted to fix setState-in-useEffect lint error in ObjectField.tsx (contains bugs)
- Removed invalid eslint-disable comment in standard-widgets.test.tsx

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-timeline/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/plugin-markdown/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/plugin-kanban/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/plugin-grid/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path, normalized alias paths, added package aliases |
| packages/plugin-form/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path, normalized alias paths, added package aliases |
| packages/plugin-editor/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/plugin-charts/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/plugin-aggrid/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path and added package aliases for test dependencies |
| packages/fields/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path, added package aliases including self-reference |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/ObjectField.tsx | Added eslint-disable comments for setState in useEffect (contains bugs) |
| packages/fields/src/widgets/BooleanField.tsx | Fixed impure Math.random() by using useId(), moved hook before early returns |
| packages/fields/src/standard-widgets.test.tsx | Removed invalid eslint-disable comment |
| packages/components/vite.config.ts | Updated setupFiles path, added package aliases including self-reference |
</details>

The eslint-disable comments claim this pattern is "required for controlled component sync", but this is incorrect. The proper pattern is to only depend on `value` in the useEffect, not on the internal state `jsonString`. These eslint-disable directives are suppressing a legitimate warning about a problematic pattern.

These comments should be removed once the dependency array is fixed (by removing `jsonString` from line 42).
